relations.name: Preserved Lemon Couscous
relations.rationale: The zesty and bright flavors of preserved lemon in the couscous complement the deep chocolate notes of the cookies, providing a refreshing contrast.

relations.name: Miso Butter Ramen
relations.rationale: The umami richness of miso butter ramen can balance the sweetness of the dark chocolate rye cookies, making for an interesting flavor pairing.

relations.name: Mojo rojo zu Kartoffelspalten von Chefkoch-Video
relations.rationale: The tangy and spicy profile of mojo rojo can create an unexpected but delightful contrast to the sweetness of the cookies.

relations.name: Original Mojo Verde from Tenerife
relations.rationale: Similar to mojo rojo, the herbaceous and slightly tangy flavor of mojo verde can pair surprisingly well with the richness of the cookies.
